class.name: BattleObject
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] A node class that implements battle objects for the combat system in UT-Godot-Engine.
class.description:
The BattleObject class may serve a similar role to the [Bullet] class, but it has no special functionality.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: fade
method.description: Fades out the battle object over 0.5 seconds before removing it from the scene.
